response.sql: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds <> 0 GROUP BY AlbumId) SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, avg_bytes_per_ms, avg_bytes_per_ms - (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) FROM album_stats) AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM album_stats ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
